opening.argument: The presentation ties Forsage partner income directly to the community’s huge turnover and claims that some partners became dollar millionaires within a few months. These claims promote a network earning opportunity through rapid, substantial returns. The speaker reinforces that appeal by saying opportunities for partners are expanding more than ever, while the description directs viewers to contact the speaker for registration instructions. Taken together, the income claims, expanding opportunities and registration invitation establish promotion of a scam recruitment opportunity: the message encourages participation rather than reporting on or critically examining the scheme.

citations.quote: The huge turnover of the Forsage community is the income of partners.
Some of the Forsage partners became dollar millonaires within a few months.
now the opportunities for our partners are expanding more than ever.
Contact me, I will explain in detail how to properly register.
